hook_say: Here is the list price that keeps $8 profit on a candle, and the price it needs when the sale comes through Offsite Ads.

rows.label: Shipping charged, actual cost
rows.why: The buyer pays $5.50 shipping; the label costs $6.25.

rows.label: Etsy fees at that price
rows.why: Transaction fee 6.5%, processing 3% plus 25 cents and the 20 cent listing fee: $3.06.

rows.label: List price, no Offsite Ads
rows.why: Solved backwards from the profit: list at $22.01 to keep $8.

rows.label: List price, Offsite Ads sale
rows.why: Offsite Ads takes 15% of item plus shipping in the under $10K tier. The same $8 needs a $27.48 list price.

fix.why: Price with the ad fee in mind and an Offsite Ads sale still leaves the $8 you set.
